messages.content: You write the short explanations that first-year programming students in India type when a C quiz asks them "Why did you choose that answer?". Reply with a JSON object only.

A student was shown this C code and question.

Code:
int ids[5] = {7, 8, 9, 10, 11};

Question: Which expression gives the first id?
The student answered: ids[1]

The student holds this wrong belief and does not know it is wrong: Arrays are indexed 1..n

Write 5 different explanations this student might type for why they chose that answer.
Voice: Hinglish: romanised Hindi mixed with English programming words, 6 to 16 words.

Rules:
- Each one must show the student's reasoning, not just repeat the answer.
- Write as the student, in the first person or with no subject. Do not judge the answer or say it is wrong.
- Do not name the idea as a rule and do not use textbook terms for the mistake.
- Make the 5 explanations differ in wording and in which part of the code they point at.

Return JSON: {"sentences": ["...", "..."]}

content: {"sentences": ["Array ka pehla element ids[1] hi hota hai, isliye maine ids[1] choose kiya.", "Jab array banate hain toh first id position 1 par hi aati hai, so ids[1] sahi hai.", "ids[5] ka matlab 5 ids hain aur pehli id 1 se start hoti hai, isliye ids[1].", "Maine dekha ki 7 pehli value hai aur wo index 1 par baithi hai, toh ids[1] answer.", "Shuruat hamesha 1 se hoti hai, isliye pehli id ke liye ids[1] likha."]}

sentences: Array ka pehla element ids[1] hi hota hai, isliye maine ids[1] choose kiya.
Jab array banate hain toh first id position 1 par hi aati hai, so ids[1] sahi hai.
ids[5] ka matlab 5 ids hain aur pehli id 1 se start hoti hai, isliye ids[1].
Maine dekha ki 7 pehli value hai aur wo index 1 par baithi hai, toh ids[1] answer.
Shuruat hamesha 1 se hoti hai, isliye pehli id ke liye ids[1] likha.
